about: The pipeline stages, in order. One source for the runner (atlas_web/runner.py), run_demo.sh, the API (/api/stages) and the UI (atlas_web/static/js/stages.js is generated from this file: python -m contracts.stages --write-js). `id` is the code/API name; `label` is the UI name; `plain` is the one-line plain-language description; `steps` are the CLI steps the stage runs, in order.

stages.label: Detect
stages.plain: Find encryption a future quantum computer could break (RSA, ECC)

stages.label: Proof Chain
stages.plain: Start the signed record: the Detect evidence is signed (ML-DSA-65) before anything else runs

stages.label: Plan
stages.plain: Schedule the migration in weekly waves (MILP, QpiAI Opt local)

stages.label: Handshakes
stages.plain: Record real TLS 1.3 handshakes from the lab services

stages.label: Gates
stages.plain: Check each wave: post-quantum handshake, downgrade refused, compatibility, rollback

stages.label: QAOA
stages.plain: Cross-check one link cutover window with QAOA on a simulator against the exact optimum

stages.label: Seal
stages.plain: Add every result to the Proof Chain and verify every signature and hash

stages.label: Report
stages.plain: Assemble, validate and sign the report
